description: Smarte Strasse: Parkplatzbelegung is a dataset listed in Datenportal Basel-Stadt open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Amt für Mobilität. Der Datensatz zeigt die Anzahl besetzter und freier Parkplätze in den beiden Zonen «blau» und «gelb». Die Detektion freier Parkplätze mittels Kamera befindet sich noch in der Testphase. Aus diesem Grund sind die Werte mit Vorsicht zu geniessen und können von den tatsächlichen Zuständen abweichen. Coverage: Canton of Basel-Stadt. The portal files it under Mobility and Transport. Its keywords are Smarte Strasse, Parkplatz. The portal shows 1 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2023-03-02 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-bs-ch-portal.
